title: Expanding data residency access to business customers worldwide
summary: OpenAI expands data residency for ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and the API Platform, enabling eligible customers to store data at rest in-region.
body: OpenAI expands data residency for ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and the API Platform, enabling eligible customers to store data at rest in-region.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布扩展ChatGPT Enterprise、Edu及API平台的数据驻留能力，允许全球企业客户将数据存储在特定区域。此举旨在满足不同国家和地区的合规性要求，降低企业在采用AI服务时的法律与数据安全顾虑。

aiReview.reasonZh: 数据驻留是企业级AI合规落地的关键基础设施，对全球化部署具有重要意义。
